name: Policy schema and identity conflicts
oracle: compile_policy/load_policy reject malformed or contradictory policies
limitations: Mostly function-level rejection checks; not every malformed policy is exercised through Docker.

name: Bounded pseudonym domains
oracle: Distinct replacement cardinality at the IPv4 limit; over-capacity refusal
limitations: IPv4 capacity is covered here; equivalent phone-capacity and forced collision exhaustion are not covered by these two cases.

name: Original-input matching and overlap
oracle: Replacement count, sampled literal absence, repeatability and overlap refusal
limitations: Stress inputs are bounded; many-literal absence is sampled rather than exhaustively checked.

name: CSV dialect and located cell/row fidelity
oracle: Unsupported/malformed dialect rejected; cells/rows reread; swaps/dropped rows rejected
limitations: Six dialect variants use the CLI and empty-output oracle; other cases mostly call adapters/verifier directly.

name: JSON parsing, numbers and encoding
oracle: Overflow/lossy numbers, depth, duplicate output keys and escaped literals; positive parsing controls
limitations: Some positive controls assert only no exception. JSON key-set, list-order and scalar mutations outside these cases need separate coverage assessment.

name: SQLite row identity, schema and integrity
oracle: Row swaps/non-text mutations rejected; trigger/rowid-shadow/view literal rejection; integrity/distinctness checks; legal sqliteX inventory and pre-verification schema mutations are checked through the complete pipeline
limitations: DDL, column and foreign-key metadata are compared. The two supplied schema mutations are not exhaustive; wider supported schemas remain workload-driven.

name: Filesystem boundaries and privacy-safe failures
oracle: Symlink/nested-root/type refusal, source-bound error redaction and CLI no-leak checks
limitations: These cases do not exercise every special-file type, error identifier, or external writer race.

name: Publication, replay and source lineage
oracle: Report/corpus existence, evidence hashes, clean output, prior release retention, changed-source digest detection; short writes must complete and zero-progress writes reject
limitations: Short/zero writes are fault-injected through the real pipeline. Broader fsync/rename/power-loss campaigns remain future hardening; the source-mutation probe is helper-level.

name: Cross-format and text verifier mutations
oracle: Restored/removed/swapped text values and JSON bool/SQLite numeric type mutation rejected
limitations: Re-derivation shares replacement primitives. One typed-scalar case contains two mutations, not two collected cases.

name: Public claims and report non-claims
oracle: Known stale prose refused; report namespace and non-claim fields present
limitations: Documentation/metadata checks, not adversarial data transformations.

name: Optional residual-risk demonstration
oracle: Quasi-identifier singleton detection and declared-model scope
limitations: Dev-only demonstration outside the release path; does not establish non-reidentifiability or close future issue 12.
